_about: ISV definitions for the LLM 'ISV fit' extraction (customer focus). For each ISV the model answers the yes/no signals below from the crawled website text only and quotes evidence; the portal then scores them with these weights (negative weight = already served / poor fit). Entries without signals are ignored. CentrePal and PulpoAR are DRAFTS built from config/packs.json; the others are stubs - fill in what_it_does, ideal_customer, signals and competitors, then restart the container.

centrepal.label: CentrePal (Teams-native contact centre)
centrepal.what_it_does: Contact centre software that runs natively inside Microsoft Teams.
centrepal.ideal_customer: Organisations that run a customer-facing contact centre or helpline and already use Microsoft 365 / Teams.

signals.question: Does the text show the organisation runs its own call centre, contact centre, helpline or customer-care line (more than just a phone number)?
Does it describe 24/7, multi-channel or high-volume customer support, a hotline or toll-free number?
Does the text mention Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 or Dynamics 365?
Does it offer WhatsApp, web chat or a customer app for service?

pulpoar.label: PulpoAR (AR virtual try-on)
pulpoar.what_it_does: Augmented-reality virtual try-on for online and in-store shopping.
pulpoar.ideal_customer: Retailers and brands selling eyewear, jewellery, watches, cosmetics or fragrance, with an online store.

signals.question: Does the organisation sell eyewear, sunglasses, jewellery, watches, makeup/cosmetics or fragrance (own brand or retail)?
Does it run an online store (add to cart, online ordering, e-commerce)?
Does it operate several stores or outlets?
Does the site already offer AR or virtual try-on?
